title: Mykolayiv State Agrarian University
summary: Mykolaiv National Agrarian University (MNAU) is a prominent public agricultural college located in Mykolaiv, Ukraine, recognized for its contributions to agrarian education and research.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Mykolaiv National Agrarian University, abbreviated as MNAU, is a public institution dedicated to agricultural education in [[mykolaiv|Mykolaiv]], [[ukraine|Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Institutional Significance
paragraphs: As the leading higher education establishment in southern Ukraine, MNAU holds a significant position in the region's educational landscape.

In the ranking of agrarian institutions of higher education with III-IV levels of accreditation, MNAU is recognized as the second best and has been awarded the honorary title of 'The Leader in Modern Science and Education.'

sections.heading: Academic Focus
paragraphs: The university's primary areas of focus include agrarian and economic education, fostering connections between academia and industry, and exploring investment processes along with innovative agricultural techniques.
